entries.reason_not_fixed: The industry negative control remains above the frozen control band across four windows, including the clean estimation window. With six effective industry groups, the weight-dispersion diagnostic has insufficient power to distinguish or exclude the candidate explanations.
entries.disposition: G4.3 completed with an unverified-control gap. Do not interpret 1.774 as evidence of industry residual common movement; retain both the WLS/Huber weighting explanation and the semantic-industry explanation as unresolved candidates. Do not add a factor, redesign the statistic, or run full coverage in this phase. Carry the limitation explicitly into G6.

entries.reason_not_fixed: The weighted random-label baseline is not centered at one under the current independent-variance normalization; the original diagnostic was not rerun in this phase.
entries.disposition: Keep as an independent calibration residual. Downstream diagnostics must not treat the weighted baseline as validated until separately recalibrated.

entries.reason_not_fixed: The failures were present when validating the evaluation-framework increment and are outside its alignment-diagnostic scope. Absence of file overlap is evidence of separation, not proof that the failures are harmless.
entries.potential_effect: The repository must not be described as full-suite green. Risk-set persistence and frozen-definition database guarantees remain unverified by the current full suite.
entries.disposition: RESOLVED 2026-08-20. All five failures were stale test fixtures from the v2 registry migration (table renames, error-code renames, retire-vs-delete semantics). Production constraints verified intact. Full suite: 198 passed.

entries.reason_not_fixed: Resolved: the former gate measured a raw reduced Gram whose condition number changed under an economically equivalent factor-column rescaling.
entries.disposition: Use full-factor-space weighted column canonicalization before the constraint null-space projection; retain published exposure and factor-return units and the original numerical-error threshold.

entries.reason_not_fixed: No variable industry-column rule has been selected. The current covariance function requires an equal-length factor axis and has no pairwise-availability or PSD-repair path.
entries.disposition: Block any remediation that creates factor-level missing returns until the ragged-panel estimator contract is implemented and tested.
